issues.description: The problem statement requires Developer.attend(course:) to accept an optional Course? and use optional binding (so students implement func attend(course: Course?)). The template declares the method with the optional parameter (func attend(course: Course?)). However the solution implements the method with a non-optional parameter (func attend(course: Course)). This cross-artifact mismatch between the specification/template and the solution can confuse students about the intended signature and the required optional handling.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the signature across artifacts. Either (A) update the solution to implement func attend(course: Course?) and use optional binding as described in the problem statement (preferred to match the teaching goal), or (B) change the problem statement and template to require a non-optional Course parameter and update instructions to remove the optional-binding requirement. Ensure all three artifacts use the same parameter type.
